lede: Fu San Auto Shine is a car workshop at Alexandra Village on Bukit Merah Lane 3. Its own website says it focuses on repair and maintenance of Continental and Japanese cars.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention detailed checks during maintenance, finding worn tyres and a cracked fan, tracing a hard-to-find noise and long-term care of a VW Golf.
faqs: The hours are listed in the Google Maps section above. Please see Google Maps for current hours.
good_to_know: Its website lists servicing, inspection, aircon repair, spray painting, wheel alignment and body repair
Its website has a request-a-call form
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, sitelift.site.
makes_note: Its website names Continental and Japanese cars. Ask the workshop about other makes.
